text: Everything so far has been screen by screen, inside Setup and Maintenance. For companies with straightforward requirements, Oracle Fusion offers a faster path: rapid implementation spreadsheets.

RI templates let a consultant define, in spreadsheet form, chart of accounts values, hierarchies, the accounting calendar, legal entities, a primary ledger, and business units — generated in one coordinated upload.
Behind the scenes: filled-in RI spreadsheets, ADFdi, the Excel add-in connecting to Oracle Fusion, FBDI for bulk data volumes, and an upload process that reads the file and creates the structures.

Rapid implementation suits simple, single-chart-of-accounts, limited-entity requirements. A complex multinational usually needs the screen-by-screen configuration this course spent five chapters covering instead.

Even a successful upload is a starting point, not a finished implementation — segment labels, balancing assignments, and cross-validation rules still need manual review. Next up, lesson twenty-eight: testing and reviewing your enterprise structure.
